metas.name: Chaos Walking
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Dune: Part Two

Two unlikely companions embark on a perilous adventure through the badlands of an unexplored planet as they try to escape a dangerous and disorienting reality where all thoughts are seen and heard by everyone.

metas.name: In the Shadow of the Moon
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved For All Mankind

The crew members of NASA's Apollo missions tell their story in their own words.

metas.name: Blade Runner 2049
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Blade Runner

Young Blade Runner K's discovery of a long-buried secret leads him to track down former Blade Runner Rick Deckard, who's been missing for thirty years.

metas.name: Paycheck
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Inception

A technical wizard learns that his memory has been erased.

metas.name: They Live
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Bugonia

They influence our decisions without us knowing it. They numb our senses without us feeling it. They control our lives without us realizing it. They live.

metas.name: Rebel Moon - Part One: A Child of Fire
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Aliens

When a peaceful settlement on the edge of a distant moon finds itself threatened by a tyrannical ruling force, a stranger living among its villagers becomes their best hope for survival.

metas.name: Beastie Boys Story
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Madonna: Truth or Dare

Here's a little story they're about to tell... Michael Diamond and Adam Horovitz share the story of the band, Beastie Boys, and 40 years of friendship in a live documentary experience directed by friend and collaborator, Spike Jonze.

metas.name: Stonehearst Asylum
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

When Dr Edward Newgate arrives at the asylum to begin his residency, he finds the Dr in charge has adopted unusual methods of treatment, methods that give his patients a lot of freedom. But cracks appear in the hospital's cheerful...

metas.name: Star Trek Beyond
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Dune: Part Two

The crew of the USS Enterprise explores the furthest reaches of uncharted space, where they encounter a new ruthless enemy, who puts them, and everything the Federation stands for, to the test.

metas.name: Don't Look Back in Anger
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved For All Mankind

Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.

metas.name: The Terminator
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Blade Runner

A cyborg assassin from the future attempts to find and kill a young woman who is destined to give birth to a warrior that will lead a resistance to save humankind from extinction.

metas.name: Push
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Inception

Two young Americans with special abilities must race to find a girl in Hong Kong before a shadowy government organization called Division does.

metas.name: Mickey 17
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Bugonia

During a human expedition to colonize space, Mickey 17, a so-called "expendable" employee, is sent to explore an ice planet.

metas.name: Alien: Resurrection
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Aliens

Two centuries after her death, a powerful human/alien hybrid clone of Ellen Ripley aids a crew of space pirates in stopping the aliens from reaching Earth.

metas.name: Selena Gomez: My Mind & Me
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Madonna: Truth or Dare

After years in the limelight, Selena Gomez achieves unimaginable stardom. But just as she reaches a new peak, an unexpected turn pulls her into darkness.

metas.name: A Scanner Darkly
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

An undercover cop in a not-too-distant future becomes involved with a dangerous new drug and begins to lose his own identity as a result.

metas.name: X-Men: Days of Future Past
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Dune: Part Two

The X-Men send Wolverine to the past in a desperate effort to change history and prevent an event that results in doom for both humans and mutants.

metas.name: Thriller 40
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved For All Mankind

Follows the making of Michael Jackson's record-breaking album "Thriller".

metas.name: Upgrade
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Blade Runner

Set in the near-future, technology controls nearly all aspects of life. But when the world of Grey, a self-labeled technophobe, is turned upside down, his only hope for revenge is an experimental computer chip implant.

metas.name: RoboCop
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Inception

In 2028 Detroit, when Alex Murphy, a loving husband, father and good cop, is critically injured in the line of duty, the multinational conglomerate OmniCorp sees their chance for a part-man, part-robot police officer.

metas.name: Britannia Hospital
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Bugonia

The chaotic workings of a hospital with staff on strike.

metas.name: Riddick
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Aliens

Left for dead on a sun-scorched planet, Riddick finds himself up against an alien race of predators. Activating an emergency beacon alerts two ships: one carrying a new breed of mercenary, the other captained by a man from Riddick...

metas.name: Rolling Thunder Revue: A Bob Dylan Story by Martin Scorsese
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Madonna: Truth or Dare

In an alchemic mix of fact and fantasy, Martin Scorsese looks back at Bob Dylan's 1975 Rolling Thunder Revue tour and a country ripe for reinvention.

metas.name: Open Grave
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

A man wakes up with no memory in a pit full of dead bodies in the wilderness and must determine if the murderer is one of the strangers who rescued him, or if he himself is the killer.

metas.name: The Time Machine
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Dune: Part Two

Hoping to alter the events of the past, a 19th century inventor instead travels 800,000 years into the future, where he finds humankind divided into two warring races.

metas.name: End of the Century: The Story of the Ramones
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved For All Mankind

The story of the punk rock band The Ramones.

metas.name: Cloud Atlas
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Blade Runner

As souls are born and reborn, they renew their connections to one another throughout the ages.

metas.name: Minority Report
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Inception

The chief of a police unit that can accurately predict and prevent crimes goes on the run after he's accused of a future murder himself.

metas.name: Repo Man
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Bugonia

A young punk, recruited by a car repo agency, finds himself in pursuit of a Chevrolet Malibu with a huge, $20,000 bounty--and something otherworldly stashed in its trunk.

metas.name: Alien³
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Aliens

Returning from LV-426, Ellen Ripley crash-lands on the maximum-security prison Fiorina 161, where she discovers that she has unwittingly brought along an unwelcome visitor.

metas.name: Sign 'o' the Times
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Madonna: Truth or Dare

Highlights from Prince's 1987 European concert tour, including selections from the rock star's album of the same title.

metas.name: The Island
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

In 2019, a mercenary pursues a man and woman who escaped a research facility after learning their true fate.

metas.name: Unknown: Cosmic Time Machine
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved For All Mankind

Follows a team of engineers and scientists in an ambitious mission to launch the James Webb Space Telescope and take the next giant leap in the understanding of the universe.

metas.name: Terminator Salvation
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Blade Runner

As the machines prepare for a final attack, John Connor and a mysterious stranger delve into the heart of Skynet and uncover a terrible secret involving the annihilation of mankind.

metas.name: The Electric State
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Inception

An orphaned teen hits the road with a mysterious robot to find her long-lost brother, teaming up with a smuggler and his wisecracking sidekick.

metas.name: They Cloned Tyrone
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Bugonia

A series of eerie events thrusts an unlikely trio onto the trail of a nefarious government conspiracy in this pulpy mystery caper.

metas.name: Voyagers
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Aliens

A crew of astronauts on a multi-generational mission descend into paranoia and madness, not knowing what is real or not.

metas.name: Die Alone
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

Tells the story of a young man who has amnesia. He bands together with a rugged survivalist in a zombie-like outbreak to find his girlfriend.

metas.name: Coldplay: A Head Full of Dreams
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved For All Mankind

The band Coldplay discuss their band, music, and rise to fame.

metas.name: Impostor
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Blade Runner

In the future, an alien race uses androids as bombs to attack Earth. A government weapons specialist is accused of being one such android and sets out to prove his innocence.

metas.name: Heart of Stone
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Inception

An intelligence operative for a shadowy global peacekeeping agency races to stop a hacker from stealing its most valuable and dangerous weapon.

metas.name: South Park: Joining the Panderverse
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Bugonia

The end of Cartman's familiar, beloved life is predicted by his incredibly unsettling dreams. As the arrival of AI upends their society, the grownups in South Park are also struggling with their own personal decisions.

metas.name: Predators
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Aliens

A group of elite warriors parachute into an unfamiliar jungle and are hunted by members of a merciless alien race.

metas.name: I Am Legend
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

Years after a plague kills most of humanity and transforms the rest into monsters, the sole survivor in New York City struggles valiantly to find a cure.

metas.name: Pavarotti
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved For All Mankind

Life, works and achievements of opera legend Luciano Pavarotti.

metas.name: 16 Blocks
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Inception

An aging alcoholic cop is assigned the task of escorting a witness from police custody to a courthouse 16 blocks away. There are, however, chaotic forces at work that prevent them from making it in one piece.

metas.name: Sunshine
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Bugonia

A team of international astronauts is sent on a dangerous mission to reignite the dying Sun with a nuclear fission bomb in 2057.

metas.name: Pandorum
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Aliens

Two crew members of a spaceship wake up from hypersleep to discover that all their colleagues are missing. Despite this, it appears that they are not alone.

metas.name: The Bay
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

Chaos breaks out in a small Maryland town after an ecological disaster occurs.

metas.name: The Maze Runner
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Inception

A teen with no memory of the outside world awakens in a gigantic maze guarded by deadly creatures, and plots a daring escape.

metas.name: Idiocracy
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Bugonia

Corporal Joe Bauers, a decidedly average American, is selected for a top-secret hibernation program but is forgotten and left to awaken to a future so incredibly moronic that he's easily the most intelligent person alive.

metas.name: Pitch Black
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Aliens

A transport ship crashes and leaves its crew stranded on a desert planet inhabited by bloodthirsty creatures that come out during an eclipse.

metas.name: Dark City
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

A man struggles with memories of his past, which include a wife he cannot remember and a nightmarish world no one else ever seems to wake up from.

metas.name: Archive
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Blade Runner

2038: George Almore is working on a true human-equivalent AI. His latest prototype is almost ready. This sensitive phase is also the riskiest. Especially as he has a goal that must be hidden at all costs.

metas.name: Deja Vu
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Inception

After a ferry is bombed in New Orleans, an A.T.F. agent joins a unique investigation using experimental surveillance technology to find the bomber, but soon finds himself becoming obsessed with one of the victims.

metas.name: The Matrix Reloaded
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Bugonia

Freedom fighters Neo, Trinity and Morpheus continue to lead the revolt against the Machine Army, unleashing their arsenal of extraordinary skills and weaponry against the systematic forces of repression and exploitation.

metas.name: 10 Cloverfield Lane
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Twelve Monkeys

A young woman is held in an underground bunker by a man who insists that a hostile event has left the surface of the Earth uninhabitable.

metas.name: Terminator 3: Rise of the Machines
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Blade Runner

John Connor must face a female Terminator with power over all the machines. But a new Terminator unit, a T-850, is sent back through time to help guide him through the coming battle.

metas.name: Tenet
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Inception

Armed with only the word "Tenet," and fighting for the survival of the entire world, CIA operative, The Protagonist, journeys through a twilight world of international espionage on a global mission that unfolds beyond real time.

metas.name: Lifeforce
metas.description:
🎯 Because you loved Aliens

A race of space vampires arrives in London and infects the populace, beginning an apocalyptic descent into chaos.
